messages:
Maya Patel: Nightly eval alert — Q4S quantized bring-up shows a repetition loop on the policy_qa prompt set (run id: ci-2026-03-19-07). repeat_rate up ~11x, lots of short loops. Posting a sample.

eval-bot: nightly-eval: model=redwood-v2-small-q4s run=ci-2026-03-19-07 metric=repeat_rate change=+1100% link: https://internal/ci/1234

Sam Turner: can you paste the raw generation? need prompt, sampling params, and model conf.

Maya Patel: ```
PROMPT: "What is the company's policy on data retention?"
GEN: "Our data retention policy is to retain data for 90 days. Our data retention policy is to retain data for 90 days. Our data retention policy is to retain data for 90 days..."
SAMPLING: temperature=0.7 top_p=0.9 max_new_tokens=256
MODEL CONF: model=redwood-v2-small checkpoint=sha256:ab12cd34 quant=q4s clamp_kv=false kv_cache_mode=packed
```

Jonas Klein: that's a classic stutter. Does it repro on fp16 (no quant)? @Lee Huang can you run a quick fp16 baseline from the same checkpoint to compare?

Lee Huang: starting fp16 run on gcp-us-west2-ml-42 (job id: job-789). ETA ~18m :hourglass:

Maya Patel: quick note — I see it only when clamp_kv=false and batch_size=1 with sequence >128. With clamp_kv=true the repeat_rate drops a lot.

Sam Turner: could be quant scaling in the attention kernels (softmax logits). Any recent kernel/regeneration touching q4s softmax? @Jonas Klein

Jonas Klein: I reverted a microkernel change two days ago but the q4s mapping was modified in the build right before this run. I'll bisect the kernel commits. If it's a truncation of logits we should see increased logit variance and repeated top tokens.

Maya Patel: as a low-risk mitigation I patched the runtime to apply small damping to attention logits for quant variants (flag: --quant-logit-damp=0.6). Can we test in staging? I'll push a canary.

Lee Huang: fp16 run completed — no loop, entropy slightly higher but outputs coherent. Suggests quant path indeed.

eval-bot: posted new eval run ci-2026-03-19-07a with quant-logit-damp=0.6 — diff vs baseline: repeat_rate -78% on policy_qa. Compare: https://internal/ci/1234/compare

Sam Turner: nice improvement. Long term we should add a nightly unit that toggles clamp_kv and q4s flags and raises an alert on >50% repeat delta for any prompt set. That would've caught this earlier.

Maya Patel: agreed. I'll add a regression alert for prompt-level repeat_rate deltas and schedule a canary rollout for q4s with the damp flag. Also listing follow-ups: 1) Jonas bisect kernel commits, 2) Lee run broader prompt suites, 3) Sam add nightly toggle test.

Lee Huang: ack — I'll run broader suite and push logs to the ticket.

Jonas Klein: starting bisect now, will report earliest bad commit.

Maya Patel: thanks all :heart: Please @mention in the ticket when you have logs.
